description: Defines a CheckListItem node for a rich text editor, including its attributes, HTML parsing/rendering, keyboard shortcuts, and node view with click handling.

classes.name: CheckListItem
classes.description: A ProseMirror node representing a checklist item with checkbox state, nested options, and custom rendering.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Provides default options for nested structure and HTML attributes.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Specifies the content model based on nesting option.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Defines the 'checked' attribute with HTML parsing and rendering logic.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Specifies how to parse HTML elements into this node.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Defines how to render this node as HTML.

methods.name: addKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Adds keyboard shortcuts for list item manipulation, including Enter, lift, and optionally Tab.

methods.name: addNodeView
methods.description: Creates a custom DOM node with click handling to toggle 'checked' state.
